## EA Media Tools 2.4.1 - jaguar

### Preset-controlled output tiers

- `presets.ini` now owns every 4K, 1080p, 720p, and 360p output resolution, target bitrate, and maximum bitrate instead of relying on application constants.
- Streaming declares encoder-family quality values for every tier, including NVENC CQ 29 at 4K and 720p, CQ 28 at 1080p, and CQ 32 for 360p/Cellular output.
- Tier overrides can independently set resolution, target/max bitrate, encoder speed, quality, and delivery-preset inheritance.
- The file begins with the validated preset source marker `[Version: bbe1a13]`. It remains metadata rather than appearing as a selectable preset, and synchronization logs report it.

### Quality and Music Video defaults

- Streaming uses a 3x bitrate buffer and spatial AQ strength 12 to give difficult dark scenes more short-term bitrate flexibility without changing CQ, encode speed, or maximum rates.
- Music Video uses P7 with a 7000 kbit/s maximum rate for 1080p sources, and P6 with an 11000 kbit/s maximum rate plus `2960:-2` scaling for 4K sources.

### Browser and Jellyfin playback

- Transcoded MP4 video retains front-loaded metadata and now adds a keyframe at least every five seconds for faster seeking and cleaner Jellyfin segment boundaries.
- HEVC MP4 output uses the `hvc1` sample entry for broader Apple and Safari direct-play compatibility.

### Logs and validation

- Activity logs now use one compact event per line. Existing logs are normalized, and FFmpeg/FFprobe events no longer add blocks of empty lines.
- Preset metadata, output tiers, tier overrides, log compaction, and MP4 playback arguments have dedicated regression coverage.

[Review changes since v2.4.0](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.4.0...v2.4.1).
